title: Schemes
longDescriptionHint: Describe the scheme in as much detail as you like: the target, the timeline, the minions involved, the backup plan, and the backup plan for the backup plan. Heroes rarely read this far.
editor.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Heroes won't wait, but this page will.
stepsEmpty: No steps yet. Every scheme starts with a single evil idea.
riskHint: Risk goes up with every hero within {{distance}} km.
backupPlansHelp: A backup plan runs automatically when a step is foiled. Keep it simple: the most successful villains have one backup plan per step and never more than three in total, because nobody remembers plan F under pressure.
approvalsHelp: Schemes with a budget over {{amount}} need the Overlord's approval before phase one. Approval usually takes a day, longer if a hero foiled something recently and the Overlord is in a mood.
monologue.placeholder: Start with why you're doing this. Heroes love a backstory.
monologueTooLong: Your monologue runs {{minutes}} minutes. Heroes escape after four.
deleteConfirm: Delete this scheme for good? All steps, backup plans and monologue drafts go with it. Heists linked to it stay, but they will need a new reason to exist.
